chapter: Road life, segregation and band pranks
title: Junior Raglin, Barney Bigard and the bottle prank
summary: Crawford tells how Bigard tricked the kleptomaniac bassist Junior Raglin into drinking from a bottle of urine.

story.theme_name: Band pranks, jokes and gigs gone wrong
story.community_name: Pranks, practical jokes and band humor

blocks.x: Now, you know when they send you the transcription back, you can bracket that as something that you don't want published.
Well, I remember some experiences that I was told, like, for instance, catch a guy like -- what was this bass player with Duke Ellington's band? Not Pettiford,
No, not him. He was nice. He can't call his name. Aline knows. Aline? [I think she] told me this one, about -- is it on?
Let me see, he had a bass player named Raglin Ragman.
I think that's the one. In the bus,
on the train, bands that could afford to ride trains, like Raglin Ellington, -- Junior Ragman, he played with Ellington.

Well, he had a habit -- he was a kleptomaniac, and he had a habit, when everybody would sleep, he would go by and find a bottle of booze, take him a good swig or two out of it. That's the way he'd get his kicks. He would get his kicks. And so, he went by one time, and a tenor saxophone player in Ellington's band, looked like white (unintelligible) saw his picture from New Orleans -- it was on your book, (unintelligible) right there on the cover.

Barney Begard. You know what happened? Stan, sit down a minute, boy, this is funny. Old Junior would go by, and he was a natural kleptomaniac, and stealing booze from everybody. Well, he found a bottle behind the seat or beside the seat. He would grab it and take him a good swig.

And so Barney Begard one time tricked him, and he peed in the bottle. And Old Junior, thinking it was booze, it was all the same color, man, he upped that bottle and swallowed that stuff. And so Barney says, now, I hope you know what you just did. Boy, those guys used to do a lot of things. (Unintelligible) told me about that.
